stories.title: Is AI Making Us Worse at Cybersecurity?
stories.description: Overreliance on AI could erode the creativity, clear communication, and critical thinking security teams need when there’s no playbook.

stories.title: Attackers Exploit UnrealIRCd Flaw That Enables Server-Level Command Injection
stories.description: CISA adds actively exploited UnrealIRCd flaw CVE-2026-114713 to its KEV catalog; linked IRC servers are at risk of command injection.

stories.title: FBI Reveals How Hackers Use ARTEX AI Agents to Gain Privileged Access in Under Three Hours
stories.description: The FBI has warned that hackers are using ARTEX AI agents to automate network attacks, with some intrusions reaching privileged access in under three hours.

stories.title: Apple Reveals How Secure Exclaves Shield Camera and Microphone Data
stories.description: The tech giant has detailed the architecture designed to isolate ambient sensor data from the main OS on HomeView and new iPhones.

stories.title: Microsoft Warns of Active Password Stealing Attack Exploiting the Microsoft 365 Service Disruption
stories.description: Microsoft has warned of an active phishing campaign using the November 12 Microsoft 365 service disruption to lure users into opening fake email recovery links.

stories.title: Cursor Reveals How a Leaked Fireworks AI Key Led to a Backdoored Claude Code Extension
stories.description: Cursor has traced its October security breach to an access key exposed by Fireworks AI. The attacker used that key to steal historical coding agent records, find more credentials, and eventually place backdoored Claude Code extensions in Cursor’s marketplace…

stories.title: No Signs of Hacking in FAA Ground Stop as FBI Reportedly Probes Software Update
stories.description: Officials say there is no evidence of a cyberattack behind the nationwide FAA outage, which may have been caused by a software update.

stories.title: CISA Warns of Check Point 0-Day Vulnerability Exploited to Gain Root Access
stories.description: CISA has warned that attackers are exploiting a Check Point security flaw that lets a local user gain root access on affected appliances.

stories.title: FAA Ground Stop Issued Due to ‘Extraordinary Circumstances’
stories.description: Federal officials have yet to say what caused the communications disruption or whether they are investigating a possible cyberattack.

stories.title: PostgreSQL Patches 52 Flaws, Including 22-Year-Old Bug Enabling Authenticated RCE
stories.description: PostgreSQL fixes 52 security flaws, including CVE-2026-6460, which allows users with object creation privileges to execute server code.

stories.title: New Mior and Skyfall Attacks Let Rogue Cloud Hosts Steal Secrets From AMD SEV-SNP VMs
stories.description: Mior and Skyfall attacks expose data in AMD SEV-SNP confidential VMs, with Mior also enabling memory changes and forged attestation reports.

stories.title: FBI Says North Korean Hackers Stole Over $400 Million in Crypto Using Deepfake Video Calls
stories.description: FBI says North Korea-linked FaceStealer stole over $400 million in crypto using fake video calls; U.S. authorities seized its infrastructure.
